# Render profiles and settings

`RenderSettings` (a resource) holds the active `RenderProfile`, the `PostSettings` and the `FogSettings`. `RenderSettings::from_profile(preset)` builds it from a `RenderProfilePreset`; `RenderSettings::default()` is `RenderProfilePreset::runtime_default` (Deck on a Steam Deck, Mobile High on Android, Desktop High elsewhere). The profile decides *what runs*; the post settings hold the user-facing values, and `RenderSettings::resolve_post` applies the profile's bloom/AA/auto-exposure switches over them. See [Rendering](../user-guide/rendering.md) and [The default look](../user-guide/default-look.md).

## Presets

| Field | Meaning | MobileLow | MobileHigh | DesktopLow | DesktopHigh | DesktopUltra | Deck |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `hdr_target` | HDR colour target format. | Rg11B10 | Rg11B10 | Rgba16f | Rgba16f | Rgba16f | Rgba16f |
| `render_scale` | Internal resolution relative to the output (TAAU upsamples). | 0.7 | 0.85 | 0.75 | 1 | 1 | 0.7 |
| `anti_aliasing` | Anti-aliasing mode. | None | Smaa | Fxaa | Taa | Taa | Taa |
| `depth_prepass` | Depth prepass before the forward pass. | false | false | true | true | true | true |
| `csm_cascade_count` | Sun shadow cascades. | 1 | 2 | 2 | 4 | 4 | 2 |
| `csm_resolution` | Shadow map edge per cascade (px). | 1024 | 2048 | 2048 | 2048 | 4096 | 2048 |
| `local_shadow_atlas_size` | Local-light shadow atlas edge (0 = off). | 0 | 4096 | 4096 | 8192 | 8192 | 4096 |
| `local_shadow_max_lights` | Local lights with shadows in the atlas. | 0 | 4 | 8 | 32 | 64 | 8 |
| `shadow_filter` | Shadow filter kernel. | Hardware2x2 | Pcf3x3 | Pcf | PcssLite | PcssLite | Pcf |
| `ssao` | Ambient occlusion mode. | Off | Off | HalfRes | GtaoHalfRes | GtaoFull | HalfRes |
| `bloom` | Bloom. | false | true | true | true | true | true |
| `bloom_mip_count` | Bloom mips. | 0 | 4 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 4 |
| `auto_exposure` | Histogram auto exposure. | false | true | true | true | true | true |
| `max_reflection_probes` | Blended reflection probes per cluster. | 1 | 2 | 2 | 4 | 4 | 2 |
| `max_lights_per_cluster` | Point/spot lights per froxel cluster. | 16 | 32 | 64 | 128 | 256 | 64 |
| `max_visible_lights` | Point/spot lights uploaded per view (ranked; drops are logged). | 32 | 64 | 128 | 256 | 512 | 96 |
| `frame_cap_fps` | Frame cap the profile installs. | none | none | none | none | none | 40 |
| `gpu_driven` | GPU frustum + Hi-Z culling, multi-draw-indirect. | false | false | true | true | true | true |
| `horizontal_plus` | Horizontal-plus FOV for non-16:9 aspects. | false | false | true | true | true | true |
| `physical_atmosphere` | Physically based atmosphere LUTs. | false | false | false | true | true | false |
| `volumetric_fog` | Froxel volumetric fog. | false | false | false | true | true | false |
| `volumetric_clouds` | Raymarched volumetric clouds. | false | false | false | true | true | false |
| `paged_sun_shadows` | Cached paged sun shadow maps. | false | false | true | true | true | true |
| `translucent_shadow_cascades` | Sun cascades with a translucency map (glass casts tinted shadows). | 0 | 1 | 2 | 4 | 4 | 2 |
| `translucent_local_shadows` | Local-light shadows see translucent casters. | false | false | true | true | true | true |
| `gi` | Diffuse GI tier. | Ambient | Ambient | Ambient | Probes | Probes | Ambient |
| `screen_space_gi` | Screen-space colour bleeding. | false | false | false | true | true | false |
| `ssr` | Screen-space reflections. | false | false | false | true | true | false |
| `reflection_probes` | Captured reflection probes. | false | false | false | true | true | false |
| `parallax_occlusion` | Parallax occlusion mapping (material scale must be set too). | false | false | false | true | true | false |
| `terrain_budget` | Opt-in cheaper terrain shading (off in every preset). | off | off | off | off | off | off |
| `depth_velocity` | Static TAAU motion reconstructed from depth. | true | true | true | true | true | true |

## Post settings (Desktop High defaults)

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch for the post stack. |
| `bloom` | `true` | Bloom (the profile can turn it off). |
| `bloom_mips` | `5` | Bloom mip count. |
| `bloom_intensity` | `0.04` | Energy-conserving blend toward the blurred image. |
| `auto_exposure` | `true` | Histogram auto exposure. |
| `exposure_ev` | `0` | Fixed EV100 when auto exposure is off. |
| `exposure_compensation` | `0` | Stops added to auto or fixed exposure. |
| `auto_exposure_min_ev100` | `-2` | Darkest scene auto exposure fully compensates. |
| `auto_exposure_max_ev100` | `15` | Brightest scene auto exposure fully compensates. |
| `tonemap` | `AgX` | `AgX`, `AcesFitted` or `Neutral`. |
| `contrast` | `1.2` | Default-look S-curve (1 = bare AgX). |
| `saturation` | `1.4` | Default-look saturation (1 = bare AgX). |
| `fxaa` | `false` | FXAA after the tonemap (set from the profile). |
| `taa` | `true` | Temporal AA / upscale (set from the profile). |
| `vignette` | `0` | Vignette strength 0–1. |
| `film_grain` | `0` | Film grain 0–1 (off for goldens). |
| `use_physical_camera` | `false` | Derive EV100 from aperture/shutter/ISO. |
| `aperture` | `16` | f-stops (physical camera). |
| `shutter_seconds` | `0.008` | Shutter time (physical camera). |
| `iso` | `100` | ISO (physical camera). |
| `grade.white_balance_kelvin` | `6500` | White balance (6500 = neutral). |
| `grade.tint` | `0` | Green–magenta tint. |
| `meter.low_percentile` | `0.4` | Histogram percentile the meter starts at. |
| `meter.high_percentile` | `0.95` | Histogram percentile the meter ends at. |
| `meter.center_weight` | `0` | Centre weighting of the meter. |
| `lut` | `none` | 3D colour LUT after the grade. |

| Preset | enabled | density | height_falloff | base_height | color | sky_inscatter |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `FogSettings::aerial()` (default) | true | 0.00022 | 0.001 | 0 | [0.7, 0.72, 0.75] | true |
